name: vinniai
description: Vinniai's Claude Code skills, installable per category: the abcdefg feature workflow, iOS simulator control, local API emulators, Taskr integration, compliance authoring, knowledge/hook authoring, plus vendored third-party skills.

plugins.name: abcdefg
plugins.description: The abcdefg seven-phase feature-development workflow — the entry skill plus its phase subskills (analyze → blueprint → construct → debug → enhance → finalize → go).

plugins.name: agent-sim
plugins.description: Drive iOS simulators headlessly via the agent-sim CLI — taps, gestures, screenshots, and a review-task queue.

plugins.name: agent-emulate
plugins.description: Local, stateful drop-in API emulators (agent-emulate) for CI and no-network dev — real OAuth/OIDC, not mocks. Covers Vercel, GitHub, Google, Slack, Apple, Microsoft, AWS, Stripe, Resend, and Next.

plugins.name: taskr
plugins.description: Integrate with the Taskr platform from outside — the REST API (taskr-api) and the taskr CLI/MCP server (taskr-cli) for auth, routes, webhooks, agent triggers, scripting, and automation.

plugins.name: compliance
plugins.description: Implement a regulatory/industry standard as structured, testable data — requirements, taxonomy, seeding, invariants, and defect SLAs.

plugins.name: authoring
plugins.description: Author and organize agent knowledge itself — decide whether something belongs in AGENTS.md, a docs index, or a skill (skill-or-agents-md), and configure Claude Code lifecycle hooks (claude-code-hooks).

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Third-party (Apache-2.0). Build distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces.

plugins.name: grill-with-docs
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Sharpen a plan against the existing domain model before building.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Third-party (MIT). Compact a conversation into a handoff document for another agent.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Third-party (Apache-2.0). Browser automation CLI for AI agents.

plugins.name: portless
plugins.description: Third-party (Apache-2.0). Named local dev-server URLs over trusted HTTPS.
